description: Look up one token and return what GROUNDTRUTH counted about it: the outcome label (rugged, died, graduated, survived, or no outcome), liquidity and market-cap figures, holder counts, and the launch counts of the wallet that launched it. Accepts a Solana mint or a Robinhood Chain 0x contract address. This is the same read the public site performs when someone pastes a contract address.

address.description: A Solana mint (base58) or a Robinhood Chain contract address (0x...). Example: So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112

name: groundtruth_scan_coin
